obligations.summary: Before making a high-risk AI system available on the market, distributors must verify it bears the required CE marking, is accompanied by the EU declaration of conformity and instructions for use, and that the provider and importer have complied with their respective obligations.

Distributors must not make a high-risk AI system available on the market if they have reason to consider it is not in conformity with Section 2 requirements, and must inform the provider or importer if the system presents a risk within the meaning of Article 79(1).
exceptions: System may be made available once brought into conformity with requirements

obligations.summary: Distributors must ensure that storage or transport conditions under their responsibility do not jeopardise the compliance of a high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Section 2.
exceptions: Applies only where storage or transport conditions are relevant

obligations.summary: Distributors must take or ensure corrective actions—including withdrawal or recall—for a high-risk AI system already made available on the market that they have reason to consider non-compliant, and must immediately inform the provider or importer and competent authorities if the system presents a risk within the meaning of Article 79(1).
exceptions: Corrective actions may alternatively be taken by the provider, importer, or any relevant operator as appropriate

obligations.summary: Upon a reasoned request from a competent authority, distributors must provide all information and documentation regarding their actions under paragraphs 1 to 4 necessary to demonstrate conformity of the high-risk AI system with Section 2 requirements.
exceptions: Obligation is triggered only upon a reasoned request from a relevant competent authority

obligations.summary: Distributors must cooperate with relevant competent authorities in any action those authorities take in relation to a high-risk AI system made available on the market, particularly to reduce or mitigate the risk posed by it.
